title: The Face as Field
question: How many different kinds of pressure can a single face hold before it stops being a face?
introduction: Twenty-four works line these walls, each built around a head. Some hold their outlines firmly; others let interior marks overwhelm structure until the face becomes a field of competing forces. Moving through the gallery, watch what happens when color, line, ground, and gesture all press inward at once — and what, if anything, remains recognizable at the end.
closing: The question the gallery opened with has no clean answer here. Each work tests a different threshold, and the line between face and field keeps moving.

chapters.title: Structure Still Holds
chapters.introduction: Four heads where a readable outline and distinct features remain, even as layered marks begin to crowd the surface. The face is present, but already under pressure.

stops.whyHere: The open white ground and heavy glasses give this head a clear armature; colored lines cross it repeatedly without yet dissolving its structure.
stops.title: nnxyz #1

stops.whyHere: The thick black outline pushes the head close to the frame; layered eye loops and exposed teeth add density while the grey ground keeps each hue distinct.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous work has open white space around it, this head fills the canvas edge to edge, tightening the pressure immediately.
stops.title: nnxyz #3

stops.whyHere: A white sticker-border contains the face against flat purple; clashing warm and cool zones inside push outward while the boundary holds them posted rather than embedded.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The grey ground gives way to saturated purple — a flat, even field that keeps the face's internal heat contained rather than released.
stops.title: nnxyz #11

stops.whyHere: A thick white outline cuts the head from its scribbled black surround; interior lines in clashing colors sit on top of each other without blending, making the face feel compressed.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The purple field is replaced by dense black scrawl filling every corner, so the surrounding field becomes as agitated as the face itself.
stops.title: nnxyz #7

chapters.title: The Split Face and the Mismatched Eye
chapters.introduction: Works where the face divides — left against right, one eye refusing to match the other — so that internal contrast becomes the subject rather than a side effect.

stops.whyHere: The face splits down the middle: dense red marks on one side, open yellow on the other, both held by a single white outline and a mouth packed with vertical white teeth.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The compressed interior of the previous work here becomes an explicit division — the face literally halved, each side governed by a different visual logic.
stops.title: nnxyz #15

stops.whyHere: Two eyes that refuse to match — one a warm target of nested rings, the other a cold spoked wheel — while comb marks above and below enforce a tense symmetry around that mismatch.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where the previous work splits the face vertically, this one splits it through the eyes alone, the rest of the composition sealed around that single point of difference.
stops.title: nnxyz #41

stops.whyHere: Blue petals and a coiled ring sit where matching eyes should be; a neat grid of white blocks spans the lower face, reading almost decorative against the surrounding tangle of olive and red.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The amber-brown ground of the previous work gives way to dark olive-green; the eye mismatch is softer here but the face remains watchful and resistant to easy reading.
stops.title: nnxyz #13

stops.whyHere: Two rectangular eye shapes, each filled with spiraling lines, read as simultaneously hollow and agitated; scattered lines at the edges feel like pressure the central form cannot contain.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The dark olive ground shifts to yellow-green, pushing the central form forward with blunt force rather than holding it in shadow.
stops.title: nnxyz #36

chapters.title: Ground as Pressure
chapters.introduction: Works where the background is not neutral — radiating slashes, dense hatching, saturated fields — so the face is squeezed from outside as well as marked from within.

stops.whyHere: Radiating yellow slashes give the orange field an outward pressure while looping teal lines pull inward; the face pushes to every edge, leaving no neutral space.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The yellow-green ground of the previous work becomes orange, and the background itself now radiates outward, reversing the direction of pressure.
stops.title: nnxyz #10

stops.whyHere: Dense overlapping strokes press against a completely still flat red field; the glasses fix one point inside the noise while a thick yellow bar cuts the right edge mid-scene.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The radiating ground of the previous work is replaced by a flat, motionless red — the contrast between active face and inert field is now at its sharpest.
stops.title: nnxyz #43

stops.whyHere: Amber fills every edge, pressing the face forward; eye sockets buried under coiled black lines feel closed or guarded, the face both present and resistant to being seen.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The flat red field becomes warm amber, and the face loses the glasses that anchored the previous work — the fixed point dissolves into layered coils.
stops.title: nnxyz 500 inks

stops.whyHere: Saturated yellow holds the dark central mass and scattered scribbles at the same visual distance; a cool green-yellow glow at the midsection pulls attention inward against the warm field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The amber ground brightens to saturated yellow; the face-form loses clear features and becomes a dark mass competing with scattered marks across the field.
stops.title: nnxyz #26

stops.whyHere: A dark shrouded form recedes into a warm amber-orange ground marked with diagonal hatching; scribbled lines pile at the base, and the face, if present, is almost entirely absorbed by the surrounding field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The saturated yellow of the previous work deepens to amber-orange; the figure loses its crown and spikes and retreats into the ground rather than pressing forward from it.
stops.title: nnxyz #18

chapters.title: Figures Under Accumulation
chapters.introduction: Heads that carry hats, hands, lettering, or companion forms — where the face shares the image with other elements that add weight, gesture, or a second focal pull.

stops.whyHere: A weighted cap dominates the upper half while the face beneath dissolves into white scribble and red stripe; a raised finger beside the head adds a blunt outward gesture.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: After the receding dark form of the previous work, a recognizable figure re-emerges — but the cap presses down while the face beneath it loses coherence.
stops.title: nnxyz #20

stops.whyHere: Arms flung wide frame the face with thin scratchy strokes; the dark hat presses down while the open mouth and spread fingers set two opposing forces against each other.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The single raised finger of the previous work expands here into both arms thrown outward, the body now fully part of the composition's pressure.
stops.title: nnxyz #48

stops.whyHere: The head pushes to all four edges of a flat pink field; a crossed-line eye reads as a target while the open-toothed mouth holds shout and snarl simultaneously.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The teal field and hat of the previous work give way to flat pink; the figure loses its arms but gains a more frontal, unmediated presence.
stops.title: nnxyz abi ninja

stops.whyHere: A dark rounded form buried under layered scribble holds a yellow X eye and a red mouth zone; scattered ovals in the upper corner keep the mood unresolved rather than settled.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The pink ground and bold outlines of the previous work are replaced by a yellow-green field and dense gray-blue scribble that buries the face's features under accumulated marks.
stops.title: nnxyz #9

stops.whyHere: Horizontal black bands ring the skull-like form while heart outlines at the lower edge pull against the harder geometry above, giving the image a divided register.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The yellow-green field shifts to salmon-pink banded with black; the skull form is softer but the horizontal pressure from outside the face intensifies.
stops.title: nnxyz #4

stops.whyHere: Red fills every corner, pressing the central black-green form forward; white outlines loop without settling into features, holding unease and absurdity in the same image.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The banded pink ground becomes saturated red, and the face loses its hat and accessories — only looping outlines remain, suggesting features without confirming them.
stops.title: nnxyz #32

chapters.title: Multiplication and Dissolution
chapters.introduction: Works where the face multiplies into several forms, or where accumulated line overwhelms any single readable head. The question of where the face ends becomes unanswerable.

stops.whyHere: Concentric gold arcs draw the eye inward while a yellow bar cuts across and a dense black-and-white row stops that pull abruptly; the face is implied by structure alone.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The saturated red of the previous work gives way to cool blue; the face retreats into geometric arcs and a mechanical X-marked circle, barely a face at all.
stops.title: nnxyz #37

stops.whyHere: A yellow field and hard red stripe divide the image into horizontal zones; two large coiled spiral forms sit as fixed points while zigzag marks above and below pulse with a different, repetitive rhythm.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The cool blue field becomes yellow and red in hard horizontal bands; the face is now a pair of spirals inside an architectural structure rather than a single head.
stops.title: nnxyz #31

stops.whyHere: A large striped head and a cluster of smaller skull forms set up a clear size contrast; the pink claws and orange X inside the large head read as markers rather than features.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The paired spirals of the previous work multiply further here into several smaller skull forms clustered beside a dominant striped head — the face becomes a repeating unit.
stops.title: nnxyz #25

stops.whyHere: Two large skull forms face outward from a near-black ground, their outlines drawn in looping lines that leave gaps; yellow angles press upward between them while layered scribbles read as noise.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The horizontal banding of the previous work gives way to a near-black ground; the skull forms are now paired and frontal, their outlines deliberately incomplete.
stops.title: nnxyz #2

stops.whyHere: Two open-mouthed forms with visible tooth rows compete with marks in every direction; a red heart in the lower right offers a quieter note without settling the surrounding conflict.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The two skull forms of the previous work become two open-mouthed forms in a grey-brown field crowded with competing marks — the face has nearly dissolved into accumulated line.
stops.title: nnxyz #5

title: Body, Mark, World
question: How much of the image does a figure need to own before the world around it takes over?
introduction: These twenty-one works begin with a single striding body and end in open landscape. Along the way figures absorb text, multiply into crowds, press against each other, and gradually cede ground to marks, light, and water. Each room tests a different balance between the human form and everything that surrounds it.
closing: The first figure strides alone; the last image holds no figure at all. What shifted, and at what point did the surrounding world become the subject?

chapters.title: One Body, Open Ground
chapters.introduction: Three figures stand or stride in clear space. Each body is the undisputed subject, yet each is already wrapped, labeled, or trailing something loose.

stops.whyHere: The striding, coil-wrapped figure with scattered dots above it opens the gallery: a single body in clear teal space, already partly unraveling upward.
stops.title: nnxyz #8

stops.whyHere: A clothed, spiked figure stands centered on black; the shirt lettering introduces text as part of the body's surface for the first time.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W016 strides on teal with loose dots above; W030 plants itself on black, replacing scattered marks with a glowing halo that clings closer to the form.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty summer night ink

stops.whyHere: Arms flung wide and feet lifted, this figure suspends itself in a teal field crowded with music notes and repeated text, the body still legible but the surrounding marks now equally active.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W030's halo stays tight to the head; here the radiating marks — wavy lines, lettering, notes — spread across the whole field, loosening the figure's grip on the space.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty summer dance ink

chapters.title: The Figure as Sign
chapters.introduction: Four works where the body wears or carries its own label. Text, logo, and object become inseparable from the figure rather than additions to it.

stops.whyHere: A stick-limbed figure holds a tilted bottle while glasses and shirt announce the work's own context; the spilling bubble shapes pull the eye away from the body.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W033's text floats free around the figure; here text is printed on the body itself and the held object extends the figure's reach outward.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty summer ink

stops.whyHere: Pizza slices crown the head and repeat as a shirt emblem; the figure is so thoroughly marked by the food motif that it becomes the figure's identity rather than a detail.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W040 carries its label in hand; W041 wears it on the head and chest simultaneously, collapsing the distance between figure and sign.
stops.title: pizza pizza pizza day

stops.whyHere: Auction-house names and art-world labels crowd every margin around a blocky head; text and image compete for the same surface without either winning.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W041's labels are cartoonish and cheerful; W039's handwritten tags carry a different charge, pressing against the figure as credential or critique rather than decoration.
stops.title: nnxyz #66

stops.whyHere: Pink lettering sits where eyes would be, turning the face into a billboard; the crosshatched background crackles with competing marks that match the face's own texture.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W039's text surrounds the figure from outside; here lettering replaces a facial feature entirely, and the background noise rises to meet the face's own density.
stops.title: nnxyz randoomdle with cap

chapters.title: Crowds, Pairs, and Scale
chapters.introduction: Works where more than one figure shares the surface. Relative size, proximity, and gesture create relationships that range from celebration to collision.

stops.whyHere: An oversized head lunges toward a tiny sign-holding companion; the scale gap between them gives the scene an uneasy, lopsided weight.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W022 shows a single face overwhelmed by marks; W004 introduces a second, much smaller figure, making scale itself the subject.
stops.title: pizza pizza pizza pizza day

stops.whyHere: Two face-forms — one small and downturned, one large and tooth-baring — share a warm yellow field with a wedge pressed between them, holding opposing moods in the same space.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W004's figures are separated by scale; W027's two faces are separated by mood, pressed into the same warm field without resolving their difference.
stops.title: pizza pizza day

stops.whyHere: A large flat-black head and two small clustered figures, one thrusting a numbered card upward, stage an announcement across a spare white ground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W027's faces share a dense, scribbled field; W002 strips the ground bare, making the scale contrast between large head and small figures starker and more deliberate.
stops.title: nnxyz 300 nifties

stops.whyHere: Three rounded figures in green, blue, and pink stand side by side, each marked with a letter; their varied poses and expressions prevent the group from reading as a single unit.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W002's small figures cluster below a dominant head; W044 gives three figures equal size and equal ground, distributing attention evenly across the trio.
stops.title: nnxyz 100 nifties

stops.whyHere: Figures stack and overlap above a blazing light source; smaller forms dissolve into the glow below, so the crowd reads as accumulation fading toward light.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W044's three figures stand distinct on grey; W018 multiplies and merges them, the radiating light pulling bodies toward dissolution rather than separation.
stops.title: nnxyz 200 nifties

stops.whyHere: Three figures share a pink field without clearly interacting; yellow dashes scatter across all of them, refusing to settle into background or foreground.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W018's figures converge on a single light source; W009's three hold their own spaces on a flat pink ground, the scattered dashes connecting them without implying relationship.
stops.title: nnxyz #12

chapters.title: Surface Under Pressure
chapters.introduction: Works where the face or body is built from competing marks, text, and color until the image feels close to overload. The figure holds, but barely.

stops.whyHere: A grinning central figure, sad-faced hearts, blue teardrops, and a small capped figure to the right send competing signals that sit unresolved across the lavender field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W009's figures coexist without drama; W008 loads the same multi-figure format with contradictory signals — bared teeth beside deflated hearts — that refuse to settle.
stops.title: nnxyz #35

stops.whyHere: Two figures press together at center, a red stroke cutting through the larger one; the image feels suspended mid-collision, neither resolved nor broken.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W008's figures are spread across the field; W025 compresses two bodies into close contact, and the red diagonal stroke introduces a physical force the earlier work kept at bay.
stops.title: nnxyz #34

stops.whyHere: A goggle-eyed figure holds the center while handwritten text crowds every edge; the warm pink corner reads as a quieter margin against the surrounding noise.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W025's pressure is physical, a stroke cutting through form; W032's pressure is textual, words pressing against the figure from all sides without touching it.
stops.title: nnxyz #64

stops.whyHere: Rectangular frames stack into a face built from competing symbols; red hand shapes at the lower corners pull outward while the dark ground compresses everything inward.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W032's text crowds the figure from outside; W020 builds the face itself from competing frames and symbols, so the pressure is structural rather than surrounding.
stops.title: nnxyz #27

stops.whyHere: A glowing yellow-gold mass anchored by dense black lines is surrounded by four open-fingered forms reaching from multiple edges; the image feels like grasping or release rather than stillness.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W020's face is built from rectangular frames; W036 dissolves the face into a glowing mass, and the reaching hand-forms replace the earlier work's compressed geometry with outward reach.
stops.title: nnxyz #30

stops.whyHere: A tightly hatched rectangular structure on the right and a looser scatter of colored loops on the left hold the image in tension between containment and open drift; no figure is clearly present.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W036's hand-forms reach outward from a central glow; W031 removes the figure entirely, leaving only the contrast between a pressured bounded form and a wandering scatter of marks.
stops.title: nnxyz #6

chapters.title: Into the World
chapters.introduction: Three works where the human form either dissolves into its surroundings or disappears. The marks that built faces and bodies now describe water, creature, and landscape.

stops.whyHere: Luminous gold and cyan curves rise from wave-like marks on a dark blue field; creature and water are described by the same short angular strokes, so their boundary stays open.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W031 holds tension between a bounded structure and loose marks; W038 carries that same tension into a subject where the boundary between form and surrounding element is equally difficult to fix.
stops.title: nnxyz Smaug on the Water

stops.whyHere: Looping white lines run across foliage, water, and sky alike, giving every surface the same restless texture; no figure is present, and the channel draws the eye into open distance.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: W038 still offers a recognizable subject rising from its ground; W035 removes any focal subject entirely, the same looping line-work now describing only landscape and light.
